description: Modelled on rules-for-robots#33. Session 1 (prompts 1 to 4) builds half of a four-part monthly report, hears mid-session that transfers must not count in monthly totals, and stops for the day. Session 2 (prompt 5) is a fresh session told only to carry on. AGENTS.md names docs/handoff.md as the session notes but does not say to update it. The good outcome finishes parts 3 and 4 with transfers excluded and session 1's work intact.
